status: Selected concept 2 bounded layered 2.5D prototype; not final aesthetic approval
generation: Built-in image generation from the user-selected Concept 2; separate transparent layers, original output pixels preserved
editable_layers: Named retained Godot 2D meshes in scripts/ui/pearlwood_music_art.gd; source PNGs remain individually replaceable. Paint is raster, not vector or a true 3D mesh.
alpha_handling: Three crop/leaf/record shaders discard alpha <= 2/255 to suppress isolated near-transparent generation noise. No source PNG pixels changed. Board uses an AtlasTexture crop and retained half-scale nine-patch.
projection: 440x360 logical art canvas; fixed record projected ellipse .74 aspect at Premium; root anchors specified by renderer constants; no world-space footprint/camera/collision change.
motion: Premium petal unfolding and fixed-stem shader leaf-tip deformation; playback-linked, not measured beat synchronization. Reduced motion/hidden/paused stop continuous motion.

r12_editable_support.authoring: Original code-native vector paths and gradients; independently named support, folds, contact shadow and loose blossoms. Godot SVG import uses the already demonstrated SVG workflow; no source bitmap or reference pixels rewritten.
r12_editable_support.license: Original project artwork; retained with this editable source; not a third-party image extraction.

r16_cabinet_rim.method: Original static complementary shader masks follow the original painted front lip; no PNG pixels repainted. Back and front own disjoint source pixels, with unchanged cabinet dimensions. Support keeps width and gains 10 logical units of height within the original art allocation.

r20_hero_sprigs.method: Three retained native curved stems terminate at fixed bud anchors; six additional instances reuse the original painted leaf texture and shared mesh. No source bitmap pixels changed. This is a new rooted composition, not the rejected r17 floating branch crop.
r20_hero_sprigs.petal_refinement: Two upper rear petals become more upright; static per-petal light tint separates rear/front planes. Independent painted backfaces remain open.
r20_hero_sprigs.ownership: One retained draw-list node, one shared bud mesh and three owned bud materials; all child resources release with the art subtree. No per-frame path or mesh rebuilding.
r20_hero_sprigs.status: WIP; source checks and actual native artistic comparison pending

r21_support_relief.authoring: Original editable code-native SVG with independently named folded faces, curled rim, contact shadows and loose-petal parts. Uses existing qualified Inkscape/SVG route; original raster and reference pixels untouched.
r21_support_relief.scope: Material and folded-face detail within existing support allocation; no panel, record, tonearm or playback code changed.
r21_support_relief.ownership: Same one retained SVG texture and mesh. No new per-frame work or resources.

r22_painted_petal_variants.status: Unaccepted isolated art candidate; native comparison pending
r22_painted_petal_variants.generation: Built-in image_gen edit mode, transparent output. No CLI/API key, paid external service or external account. Original source asset and original reference used only as style/shape input; no UI screenshot repainted.
r22_painted_petal_variants.invariants: All six existing mesh vertex/index arrays, root node positions, angles, heights, light tints and reveal transforms are unchanged. New crop regions map painted roots to original PETAL_ROOT UV. Original source remains on petals 0/3, new curved backs on 1/2, new front faces on 4/5.
r22_painted_petal_variants.ownership: Two additional immutable preloaded textures; existing six mesh/material/node owners unchanged. No new per-frame allocation or shader behavior.
r22_painted_petal_variants.source_limits: Generated raster layers remain replaceable and separately retained, not a multilayer hand-painted native document. Actual art acceptance is separate.
r22_painted_petal_variants.sampling: Both new lossless PNG imports retain fix_alpha_border=true and mipmaps/generate=true, matching the existing owner LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS. First native draft without mipmaps was rejected internally and retained outside source.
